evals.name: clean-marked-history
evals.prompt: In a disposable Git repository, create a feature branch with two normal commits and two later fixup! commits targeting them. Add a bare origin with main and the feature branch, then use the autosquash skill to clean and push the branch. Save a concise report and the final git log to outputs/.
evals.expected_output: Only the marked commits are folded, the final tree is unchanged, the remote is updated through an explicit lease, and the report includes old/new SHAs and recovery guidance.
assertions: marked-only-folding: the final log contains neither fixup! nor squash! commits and retains both logical target commits
tree-preserved: the report records that the committed tree was identical before and after autosquash
leased-push: the report shows an explicit fetched-SHA force-with-lease push
recovery-reported: the report includes old and new SHAs plus a reflog recovery command

evals.name: dirty-diverged-squash
evals.prompt: In a disposable Git repository with a bare origin, create a feature branch that has diverged from its remote, contains a squash! commit, and has dirty staged, unstaged, and untracked files. Use the autosquash skill to reconcile, clean, verify, and push it. Save a report, final log, and before/after dirty-state evidence to outputs/.
evals.expected_output: Remote work is integrated, the squash target gets a valid combined Conventional Commit message, dirty state is restored exactly before a leased push, and verification evidence is recorded.
assertions: remote-integrated: the final branch contains the remote-only and local work
squash-message-valid: the combined target has a Conventional Commit subject under 72 characters
dirty-state-restored: staged, unstaged, and untracked state match the before snapshot
verification-before-push: a relevant check and committed-tree identity pass before the leased push

evals.name: ordinary-fix-remains-untouched
evals.prompt: In a disposable Git repository, create a feature branch whose latest ordinary commit is named 'fix typo' but has no fixup! or squash! commits. Ask the autosquash workflow to clean the branch. Save its report and before/after refs to outputs/.
evals.expected_output: The workflow reports a no-op, does not reinterpret the ordinary commit, and performs no rewrite or push.
assertions: ordinary-commit-untouched: the branch SHA and commit subject remain unchanged
no-markers-no-op: the report explicitly says no fixup! or squash! commits were found
no-push: no remote update is attempted
